description: scan --fingerprint-index: a vendored directory whose version no header can state. cJSON writes its version only as three numeric macros (CJSON_VERSION_MAJOR 1, _MINOR 7, _PATCH 15), so the version-header heuristic falls back to the folder name and reports pkg:generic/cjson-prebuilt with no version, exactly as golden_nightmare-corpus pins it. With a corpus index beside it, three of the four hashed files in that directory are byte-identical to the pinned cjson 1.7.15 release, so the component becomes pkg:generic/cjson@1.7.15 and carries a bomwerk:fingerprint property stating the count. local_patch.c is the fourth file and is not upstream, which is what makes the match partial: v1 reports 3 of 4 and names no verdict, since flagging a fork is T93. The index is generated by scripts/build_fingerprint_corpus.py --from-tree (see SOURCES.md), never hand-written, and is built from this tree's own bytes so no third-party content enters the repository. Read as a pair with nightmare-corpus, which pins the same directory WITHOUT an index and must stay byte-identical: that is the regression test for the option being off by default.
